mutation.description: Sets the optional top-level cbc:CopyIndicator to a value outside the XML Schema boolean datatype.
Adds an XAdES Identifier whose Qualifier is outside the UBL-imported OIDAsURI/OIDAsURN enumeration.
Moves the required top-level Invoice ID into an unrecognized namespace instead of UBL Common Basic Components.
Removes the Invoice closing tag so the fixture is not well-formed XML.
Removes the required top-level cbc:ID from the Invoice sequence.
Places required cbc:IssueDate before required cbc:ID, violating the Invoice XSD sequence.
